Deal size and closure are stock-moving; sets capital deployment and balance sheet trajectory.
Adds leverage and interest expense; shifts capital structure near term.
Boosts top line; scale benefits could aid operating leverage.
Implied 8.9x multiple frames expected return; synergy delivery is key.
Valuation benchmark vs peers/deals; suggests accretive potential if realized.

This is a mid-cycle expansion move, closing previously announced deals to scale Environmental Services. A larger catalyst requires clear evidence of synergy capture, EBITDA accretion in results, and stable leverage post notes issuance.
